headline: CIN @ SDP matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CIN 4.00 at SDP 3.55, with a projected total of 7.55. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CIN: CIN moved +0.27 runs while SDP moved -0.65, changing the projected margin by +0.91 runs. The projected total fell -0.38, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +6.1%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Chase Burns has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for JJ Bleday, Fernando Tatis Jr., Blake Dunn, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Eugenio Suárez, Bryce Johnson because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
